briefdescription.para: Attempts to exchange the given object for a specified number of trials.

detaileddescription.para: When Two threads rendezvous via this function, they will atomically exchange the provided pointers/objects. To increase the probability of two threads meeting at the same time, this thread will repeatedly try to find another thread for a specified number of trials.

parameterdescription.para: address of the object to exchange. Can be NULL，if the calling thread wants to only consume.
the maximum number of exchange trials.
output parameter. true: exchange was successful. false: exchange failed within the given number of trials.

simplesect.para: void* address of exchanged object on successful exchange.
NULL if no exchange could be conducted within max_trials bound.

detaileddescription.para: Using the lock-free exchanger two threads can rendezvous to exchange objects The exchange protocol is lock-free and it is deployed in lock-free stack implementations.
Maurice Herlihy, Nir Shavit - [The Art of Multiprocessor Programming 11.4.1] (https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.5555/2385452)
